name: @rxycode/desktop-app
description: RxyCode Desktop: Electron + Vite + React main window (session list, chat area, composer) wired to @rxycode/protocol-client (Phase4-D2).
author: RxyCode

scripts.test: node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --test src/renderer/src/lib/approvalPolicy.test.mts src/renderer/src/lib/conversationStore.test.mts src/renderer/src/lib/appserver.integration.test.mts src/renderer/src/lib/workspaceSettings.test.mts src/platform/index.test.mts src/main/external-url.test.mts src/main/kill-tree.test.mts src/main/lockfile.test.mts src/main/navigation.test.mts src/main/workspace-dialog.test.mts src/main/runtime.test.mts src/main/appserver-runtime.test.mts src/main/auto-update.test.mts src/main/crash-report.test.mts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build:unpack: npm run build && npm run runtime:prepare && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm run runtime:prepare && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:win:zip: npm run build && npm run runtime:prepare && electron-builder --win zip
scripts.build:mac: electron-vite build && npm run runtime:prepare -- --platform darwin && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: electron-vite build && npm run runtime:prepare -- --platform linux && electron-builder --linux
